title: Chicken Skewers Provençale
description: A French-inspired recipe featuring marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection. This dish is perfect for a quick and flavorful meal.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.notes: boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, chili powder, and lemon juice.
Add chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Soak skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
